
        <h2 class="post-title">
            <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/leee99/p/21506822/aliyun-llmstxt" title="发布于 2026-07-15 17:18">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">阿里云官方技术文档已全面上线 llms.txt —— AI Agent 一站式消费 300+ 款云产品文档</span>
    

</a>

        </h2>
            <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        所有阿里云产品的技术文档、API 参考、最佳实践，均可通过 llms.txt 结构化索引高效检索和消费。无论您使用 Qwen、GPT、Claude、DeepSeek、Kimi 还是豆包，只需一个 URL 即可获取完整的阿里云知识体系。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-lake-id="a20d224c568e48b9d67847a2c66a8c01_p_0"><span data-spm-anchor-id="a2c6h.12873639.article-detail.i0.7b5d7bf2X6YBJO" data-ai-assistant-role="selection">所有阿里云产品的技术文档、API 参考、最佳实践，均可通过 llms.txt 结构化索引高效检索和消费。无论您使用 Qwen、GPT、Claude、DeepSeek、Kimi 还是豆包，只需一个 URL 即可获取完整的阿里云知识体系。</span></p>
<h2 id="slide-0" data-lake-id="651dbe939045723830e5c764ffdc8ba1">llms.txt 入口地址</h2>
<p data-lake-id="4dee5a52ab92d487e355f5fe1bd726dc">阿里云官方技术文档提供中国站和国际站两套独立站点，共覆盖 <strong>6 个语言版本</strong>的 llms.txt 索引：</p>
<h3 id="slide-1" data-lake-id="e11dde9f0c733dfe4edb1b5f70e92436">中国站（help.aliyun.com）</h3>
<div id="Z3Idk" data-card-type="block" data-lake-card="table" <h3 id="slide-3" data-lake-id="e06a33ff6d91bfffe6adafe7e26b2634">根索引</h3>
<p data-lake-id="990dc107ebd20b86b961b56bf102b5ec">上述多语言入口的汇总索引位于：</p>

<h2 id="slide-4" data-lake-id="7e0640715a161bfa6852d8f7b6da8aa4">llms.txt 的结构</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># 产品名称
&gt; 产品一句话描述（供 AI 快速判断是否相关）
## 分类名称
- [页面标题](URL): 页面描述（告诉 AI 这个页面能解决什么问题）
- [页面标题](URL): 页面描述</pre>
</div>
<p data-lake-id="2143cc71173d895116a7b86179fd269e">阿里云的 llms.txt 采用<strong>两级索引</strong>架构，根索引和产品索引各司其职：</p>
<ul data-lake-id="ed0379cc76a45de29eb50d3ce1ba123e">
<li data-lake-id="f0b1abcbe9c8db2cf796a75fbea0d173"><strong>第一级：根索引</strong>（<code>help.aliyun.com/zh/llms.txt</code>）—— 列出所有产品，每个产品指向自己的 llms.txt：</li>
</ul>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># 阿里云帮助文档
&gt; 阿里云（Alibaba Cloud）是全球领先的云计算及人工智能科技公司之一。提供全栈云服务...
## 人工智能与机器学习
- [人工智能平台 PAI](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pai/llms.txt): 覆盖 AI 开发全流程：DSW 建模、DLC 分布式训练、EAS 推理部署...
- [大模型服务平台百炼](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/model-studio/llms.txt): 集成千问、DeepSeek 等模型，提供兼容 OpenAI 的 API...
## 存储
- [对象存储](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/llms.txt): OSS 按需存储和访问任意类型数据的 IaaS 存储服务...
- [文件存储NAS](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/nas/llms.txt): 兼容 POSIX/NFS/SMB 协议的分布式文件系统...
## 计算
- [云服务器 ECS](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ecs/llms.txt): 按需创建和管理虚拟机实例的 IaaS 能力...
...共 300+ 款产品</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<ul data-lake-id="c5a66b56358a03200e8f37e10e6865e7">
<li data-lake-id="37e981dfc0ccb783d353c5f0c2651190"><strong>第二级：产品索引</strong>（如 <code>help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/llms.txt</code>）—— 列出该产品的所有文档页面：</li>
</ul>
<div id="2EduA" data-card-type="block" data-lake-card="codeblock" data-card-value="data:%7B%22mode%22%3A%22plain%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22%23%20%E5%AF%B9%E8%B1%A1%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%5Cn%3E%20%E5%AF%B9%E8%B1%A1%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%20OSS%EF%BC%88Object%20Storage%20Service%EF%BC%89%E6%8C%89%E9%9C%80%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%E5%92%8C%E8%AE%BF%E9%97%AE%E4%BB%BB%E6%84%8F%E7%B1%BB%E5%9E%8B%E3%80%81%E4%BB%BB%E6%84%8F%E8%A7%84%E6%A8%A1%E6%95%B0%E6%8D%AE%E7%9A%84%20IaaS%20%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%E6%9C%8D%E5%8A%A1...%5Cn%23%23%20%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E6%8C%87%E5%8D%97%5Cn-%20%5B%E5%AF%B9%E8%B1%A1%E5%AD%98%E5%82%A8%20OSS%20%E6%A6%82%E8%BF%B0%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fhelp.aliyun.com%2Fzh%2Foss%2Fuser-guide%2Fwhat-is-oss.md)%3A%20OSS%20%E6%A0%B8%E5%BF%83%E6%A6%82%E5%BF%B5%EF%BC%88Bucket%2FObject%2FEndpoint%2FAccessKey%EF%BC%89%E3%80%81%E5%B7%A5%E4%BD%9C%E5%8E%9F%E7%90%86...%5Cn-%20%5BOSS%20%E8%B7%A8%E5%9F%9F%E8%AE%BE%E7%BD%AE%20CORS%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fhelp.aliyun.com%2Fzh%2Foss%2Fuser-guide%2Fconfigure-cross-origin-resource-sharing.md)%3A%20%E9%85%8D%E7%BD%AE%20CORS%20%E8%A7%84%E5%88%99%E8%A7%A3%E5%86%B3%E6%B5%8F%E8%A7%88%E5%99%A8%E8%B7%A8%E5%9F%9F%E9%94%99%E8%AF%AF...%5Cn-%20%5B%E6%8E%A7%E5%88%B6%E5%8F%B0%E5%BF%AB%E9%80%9F%E5%85%A5%E9%97%A8%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fhelp.aliyun.com%2Fzh%2Foss%2Fuser-guide%2Fconsole-quick-start.md)%3A%2010%20%E5%88%86%E9%92%9F%E5%AE%8C%E6%88%90%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%20Bucket%E3%80%81%E4%B8%8A%E4%BC%A0%2F%E4%B8%8B%E8%BD%BD%20Object...%5Cn%23%23%20%E5%BC%80%E5%8F%91%E5%8F%82%E8%80%83%5Cn-%20%5BPutBucketCors%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fhelp.aliyun.com%2Fzh%2Foss%2Fdeveloper-reference%2Fputbucketcors.md)%3A%20%E8%AE%BE%E7%BD%AE%20CORS%20%E8%A7%84%E5%88%99%E7%9A%84%20API%20%E5%8F%82%E8%80%83...%5Cn...%22%2C%22id%22%3A%222EduA%22%7D" data-language="plain">
<div class="lake-codeblock-content">
<div class="CodeMirror-sizer">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># 对象存储
&gt; 对象存储 OSS（Object Storage Service）按需存储和访问任意类型、任意规模数据的 IaaS 存储服务...
## 用户指南
- [对象存储 OSS 概述](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/user-guide/what-is-oss.md): OSS 核心概念（Bucket/Object/Endpoint/AccessKey）、工作原理...
- [OSS 跨域设置 CORS](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/user-guide/configure-cross-origin-resource-sharing.md): 配置 CORS 规则解决浏览器跨域错误...
- [控制台快速入门](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/user-guide/console-quick-start.md): 10 分钟完成创建 Bucket、上传/下载 Object...
## 开发参考
- [PutBucketCors](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/developer-reference/putbucketcors.md): 设置 CORS 规则的 API 参考...
...</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-lake-id="f7807b43242fc9421cf81c5ee3a724b1">两级索引中链接的区别：</p>
<ul data-lake-id="c87ae27292603e9e6589704a64b61ee5">
<li data-lake-id="ddb496ae3edd4490be8a3b2b186759f8">根索引的链接指向 → <strong>产品的 llms.txt</strong>（如 <code>/zh/oss/llms.txt</code>）</li>
<li data-lake-id="e56dbbf83d04459ab82074953e69eeef">产品索引的链接指向 → <strong>具体文档页面</strong>（如 <code>/zh/oss/user-guide/xxx.md</code>）</li>
</ul>
<p data-lake-id="23422d7a0a72a2c1bb3af3ba33e55588">AI Agent 消费时，先读根索引定位目标产品，再读产品索引获取具体文档页面，最后按需抓取 Markdown 正文——<strong>三步定位，按需加载，不浪费 token</strong>。</p>
<div data-card-type="block" data-lake-card="hr"><hr></div>
<h2 id="slide-5" data-lake-id="5641653f1b4a3faeb93fcc25045c5242">AI 模型如何使用 llms.txt</h2>
<h3 id="slide-6" data-lake-id="c090eb4f16aae3629601218fe89da65d">消费流程</h3>
<div id="39AHJ" data-card-type="block" data-lake-card="codeblock" data-card-value="data:%7B%22mode%22%3A%22plain%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E6%8F%90%E9%97%AE%5Cn%20%20%5C%22%E5%A6%82%E4%BD%95%E5%9C%A8%20ECS%20%E4%B8%8A%E9%83%A8%E7%BD%B2%20GPU%20%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B%EF%BC%9F%5C%22%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%E2%94%82%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%E2%96%BC%5Cn%E2%94%8C%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%90%5Cn%E2%94%82%20Step%201%3A%20%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E6%A0%B9%E7%B4%A2%E5%BC%95%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%E2%94%82%20%20GET%20help.aliyun.com%2Fzh%2Fllms.txt%5Cn%E2%94%82%20%E2%86%92%20%E6%89%BE%E5%88%B0%20ECS%20%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81%E5%85%A5%E5%8F%A3%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%E2%94%82%20%20%20%E2%86%92%20help.aliyun.com%2Fzh%2Fecs%2Fllms.txt%5Cn%E2%94%94%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%AC%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%98%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%E2%96%BC%5Cn%E2%94%8C%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%90%5Cn%E2%94%82%20Step%202%3A%20%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81%E7%B4%A2%E5%BC%95%20%20%20%20%20%20%E2%94%82%20%20GET%20help.aliyun.com%2Fzh%2Fecs%2Fllms.txt%5Cn%E2%94%82%20%E2%86%92%20%E6%A0%B9%E6%8D%AE%E6%8F%8F%E8%BF%B0%E5%8C%B9%E9%85%8D%E7%9B%B8%E5%85%B3%E9%A1%B5%E9%9D%A2%20%20%20%20%20%20%E2%94%82%20%20%E2%86%92%20%5C%22GPU%20%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B%E8%A7%84%E6%A0%BC%E6%97%8F%5C%22%5C%22%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%20GPU%20%E5%AE%9E%E4%BE%8B%5C%22%5Cn%E2%94%94%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%AC%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%98%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%E2%96%BC%5Cn%E2%94%8C%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%90%5Cn%E2%94%82%20Step%203%3A%20%E6%8A%93%E5%8F%96%E7%9B%AE%E6%A0%87%E9%A1%B5%E9%9D%A2%20%20%20%20%20%20%E2%94%82%20%20GET%20%E5%85%B7%E4%BD%93%E6%96%87%E6%A1%A3%20URL%EF%BC%88.md%20%E6%88%96%20HTML%EF%BC%89%5Cn%E2%94%82%20%E2%86%92%20%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96%E8%AF%A6%E7%BB%86%E5%86%85%E5%AE%B9%E5%9B%9E%E7%AD%94%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%20%20%20%20%20%20%E2%94%82%5Cn%E2%94%94%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%80%E2%94%98%22%2C%22id%22%3A%2239AHJ%22%7D" data-language="plain">
<div class="lake-codeblock-content">
<div class="CodeMirror-sizer">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>用户提问
  "如何在 ECS 上部署 GPU 实例？"
      │
      ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ Step 1: 读取根索引        │  GET help.aliyun.com/zh/llms.txt
│ → 找到 ECS 产品入口       │   → help.aliyun.com/zh/ecs/llms.txt
└────────────┬────────────┘
             ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ Step 2: 读取产品索引      │  GET help.aliyun.com/zh/ecs/llms.txt
│ → 根据描述匹配相关页面      │  → "GPU 实例规格族""创建 GPU 实例"
└────────────┬────────────┘
             ▼
┌─────────────────────────┐
│ Step 3: 抓取目标页面      │  GET 具体文档 URL（.md 或 HTML）
│ → 获取详细内容回答问题      │
└─────────────────────────┘</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-lake-id="335f69cb806dbcc23e9b67c3ec0b87c1">这个三步流程让 AI 模型能够<strong>精准导航到目标文档</strong>，而不是在数万页文档中盲目搜索。</p>
<div data-card-type="block" data-lake-card="hr"><hr></div>
<h2 id="slide-7" data-lake-id="84a3a2703e7246770509967d5c2ca68e">使用示例</h2>
<h3 id="slide-8" data-lake-id="5ec816d9958fadee555b11a6ba367067">示例 1：在 AI 对话产品中直接使用</h3>
<p data-lake-id="0658e491df13fa924b9f53b6a73dfdce">Qoder、Kimi、ChatGPT、Claude 、豆包等 AI 对话产品内置了网页抓取能力，可以直接通过对话指令消费 llms.txt，无需写代码。</p>
<p data-lake-id="2c0307117eb21ce2ce241c6b46a68d73"><strong>直接给模型发指令：</strong></p>
<div id="FGjsT" data-card-type="block" data-lake-card="codeblock" data-card-value="data:%7B%22mode%22%3A%22plain%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22%E8%AF%B7%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96https%3A%2F%2Fhelp.aliyun.com%2Fzh%2Fllms.txt%EF%BC%8C%5Cn%E6%89%BE%E5%88%B0%5C%22%E5%87%BD%E6%95%B0%E8%AE%A1%E7%AE%97%5C%22%E7%9B%B8%E5%85%B3%E7%9A%84%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81%EF%BC%8C%5Cn%E7%84%B6%E5%90%8E%E5%B8%AE%E6%88%91%E6%9F%A5%E7%9C%8B%E5%A6%82%E4%BD%95%E7%94%A8%20Python%20%E7%BC%96%E5%86%99%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AA%20HTTP%20%E8%A7%A6%E5%8F%91%E5%99%A8%E7%9A%84%E4%BA%91%E5%87%BD%E6%95%B0%E3%80%82%22%2C%22id%22%3A%22FGjsT%22%7D" data-language="plain">
<div class="lake-codeblock-content">
<div class="CodeMirror-sizer">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>请读取https://help.aliyun.com/zh/llms.txt，
找到"函数计算"相关的产品，
然后帮我查看如何用 Python 编写一个 HTTP 触发器的云函数。</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-lake-id="739e853cf79eeeddbf4f9234ed494390"><strong>AI 实际执行过程：</strong></p>
<div id="2Ex0P" data-card-type="block" data-lake-card="codeblock" data-card-value="data:%7B%22mode%22%3A%22plain%22%2C%22code%22%3A%221.%20Fetch(https%3A%2F%2Fhelp.aliyun.com%2Fzh%2Fllms.txt)%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%E2%86%90%20%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E6%A0%B9%E7%B4%A2%E5%BC%95%5Cn%20%20%20%E2%86%92%20%E6%89%BE%E5%88%B0%E5%87%BD%E6%95%B0%E8%AE%A1%E7%AE%97%E6%9D%A1%E7%9B%AE%EF%BC%8C%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81%20llms.txt%20%E9%93%BE%E6%8E%A5%5Cn2.%20Fetch(https%3A%2F%2Fhelp.aliyun.com%2Fzh%2Ffunctioncompute%2Fllms.txt)%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%E2%86%90%20%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81%E7%B4%A2%E5%BC%95%5Cn%20%20%20%E2%86%92%20%E6%8C%89%E5%85%B3%E9%94%AE%E8%AF%8D%E5%8C%B9%E9%85%8D%E5%88%B0%20HTTP%20%E8%A7%A6%E5%8F%91%E5%99%A8%E3%80%81Python%20%E8%BF%90%E8%A1%8C%E6%97%B6%E7%9B%B8%E5%85%B3%E6%96%87%E6%A1%A3%5Cn3.%20Fetch(https%3A%2F%2Fhelp.aliyun.com%2Fzh%2Ffunctioncompute%2F...%2Fhttp-trigger-invoking-function.md)%20%20%E2%86%90%20%E6%8A%93%E5%8F%96%E7%9B%AE%E6%A0%87%E9%A1%B5%E9%9D%A2%5Cn%20%20%20%E2%86%92%20%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96%E8%AF%A6%E7%BB%86%E5%86%85%E5%AE%B9%EF%BC%8C%E7%94%9F%E6%88%90%E5%9B%9E%E7%AD%94%22%2C%22id%22%3A%222Ex0P%22%7D" data-language="plain">
<div class="lake-codeblock-content">
<div class="CodeMirror-sizer">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>1. Fetch(https://help.aliyun.com/zh/llms.txt)                           ← 读取根索引
   → 找到函数计算条目，获取产品 llms.txt 链接
2. Fetch(https://help.aliyun.com/zh/functioncompute/llms.txt)           ← 读取产品索引
   → 按关键词匹配到 HTTP 触发器、Python 运行时相关文档
3. Fetch(https://help.aliyun.com/zh/functioncompute/.../http-trigger-invoking-function.md)  ← 抓取目标页面
   → 获取详细内容，生成回答</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-lake-id="65aebf377aebb9ccbf8a60285f40f6a9">AI 会自动完成”根索引 → 产品索引 → 具体文档页面“的三步导航，最终基于真实文档内容回答问题，并附上来源链接。</p>
<blockquote>
<p data-lake-id="9db39c681fb13d7a612577012a0b96be"><strong>提示</strong>：回答中引用的文档链接默认为 <code>.md</code> 格式，去掉 <code>.md</code> 后缀即为对应的 HTML 页面。例如：</p>
<ul data-lake-id="bdb7c072f760e878237281861230a3ec">
<li data-lake-id="ddb4471c3351b1a01362fb4d3e45238e"><span class="lake-fontsize-12">AI 返回：<code><span class="lake-fontsize-12"><a href="https://help.aliyun.com/zh/functioncompute/fc/user-guide/http-trigger-invoking-function.md?spm=a2c6h.13046898.publish-article.29.173f6ffaJaElfJ&amp;file=http-trigger-invoking-function.md" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">https://help.aliyun.com/zh/functioncompute/fc/user-guide/http-trigger-invoking-function.md</a></span></code></span></li>
<li data-lake-id="4f05e3c40f0730b5b6d7763b26742f14"><span class="lake-fontsize-12">浏览器访问：<code><span class="lake-fontsize-12"><a href="https://help.aliyun.com/zh/functioncompute/fc/user-guide/http-trigger-invoking-function?spm=a2c6h.13046898.publish-article.30.173f6ffaJaElfJ" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">https://help.aliyun.com/zh/functioncompute/fc/user-guide/http-trigger-invoking-function</a></span></code></span></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<p data-lake-id="b0aef5d73e3eb78e39f00ebffa3bce48"><strong>在 System Prompt 中配置为知识源（适用于Qoder / 自建 GPTs / Kimi 智能体等）：</strong></p>
<div id="lChES" data-card-type="block" data-lake-card="codeblock" data-card-value="data:%7B%22mode%22%3A%22plain%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22%E4%BD%A0%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%80%E4%B8%AA%E9%98%BF%E9%87%8C%E4%BA%91%E6%9E%B6%E6%9E%84%E5%B8%88%E5%8A%A9%E6%89%8B%E3%80%82%5Cn%E9%98%BF%E9%87%8C%E4%BA%91%E6%89%80%E6%9C%89%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81%E6%96%87%E6%A1%A3%E7%9A%84%E7%B4%A2%E5%BC%95%E4%BD%8D%E4%BA%8E%20https%3A%2F%2Fhelp.aliyun.com%2Fzh%2Fllms.txt%5Cn%E5%9B%9E%E7%AD%94%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%E6%97%B6%EF%BC%8C%E5%85%88%E4%BB%8E%E7%B4%A2%E5%BC%95%E4%B8%AD%E5%AE%9A%E4%BD%8D%E7%9B%B8%E5%85%B3%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81%EF%BC%8C%E5%86%8D%E6%8A%93%E5%8F%96%E5%85%B7%E4%BD%93%E6%96%87%E6%A1%A3%E9%A1%B5%E9%9D%A2%E3%80%82%5Cn%E5%9B%9E%E7%AD%94%E4%B8%AD%E5%BC%95%E7%94%A8%E6%96%87%E6%A1%A3%E9%93%BE%E6%8E%A5%E6%97%B6%EF%BC%8C%E5%8E%BB%E6%8E%89%E6%9C%AB%E5%B0%BE%E7%9A%84%20.md%20%E5%90%8E%E7%BC%80%EF%BC%8C%E8%BF%94%E5%9B%9E%20HTML%20%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC%E4%BE%BF%E4%BA%8E%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E7%9B%B4%E6%8E%A5%E8%AE%BF%E9%97%AE%E3%80%82%22%2C%22id%22%3A%22lChES%22%7D" data-language="plain">
<div class="lake-codeblock-content">
<div class="CodeMirror-sizer">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>你是一个阿里云架构师助手。
阿里云所有产品文档的索引位于 https://help.aliyun.com/zh/llms.txt
回答用户问题时，先从索引中定位相关产品，再抓取具体文档页面。
回答中引用文档链接时，去掉末尾的 .md 后缀，返回 HTML 版本便于用户直接访问。</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<h3 id="slide-9" data-lake-id="8c8818b1ba618fc8631de49eb87fd1cb">示例 2：在通义灵码 CLI（Qoder CLI）中消费 llms.txt</h3>
<p data-lake-id="d9baea486930d8b47adf420795345615"><a href="https://lingma.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c6h.13046898.publish-article.31.173f6ffaJaElfJ" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">通义灵码</a> 是阿里云的智能编码助手，其 CLI 模式（qodercli）内置 WebFetch 工具，能够直接抓取 URL。通过项目级 <code>AGENTS.md</code> 配置文档查阅规则，即可让它自主导航 llms.txt。</p>
<h4 id="slide-10" data-lake-id="255ec801f6630940077e8f46356fb09b">配置方法</h4>
<p data-lake-id="e3c4410a0d6e00947e80e9bba8b7d59e">在项目根目录创建 <code>AGENTS.md</code>：</p>
<div id="HU5oi" data-card-type="block" data-lake-card="codeblock" data-card-value="data:%7B%22mode%22%3A%22plain%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22%23%20%E9%98%BF%E9%87%8C%E4%BA%91%E6%96%87%E6%A1%A3%E6%9F%A5%E9%98%85%E8%A7%84%E5%88%99%5Cn%E5%BD%93%E9%9C%80%E8%A6%81%E6%9F%A5%E8%AF%A2%E9%98%BF%E9%87%8C%E4%BA%91%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81%E6%96%87%E6%A1%A3%E6%97%B6%EF%BC%8C%E8%AF%B7%E6%8C%89%E4%BB%A5%E4%B8%8B%E6%AD%A5%E9%AA%A4%E6%93%8D%E4%BD%9C%EF%BC%9A%5Cn1.%20%E5%85%88%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%20https%3A%2F%2Fhelp.aliyun.com%2Fzh%2Fllms.txt%20%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81%E7%B4%A2%E5%BC%95%5Cn2.%20%E6%A0%B9%E6%8D%AE%E9%97%AE%E9%A2%98%E5%AE%9A%E4%BD%8D%E5%88%B0%E5%85%B7%E4%BD%93%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81%E7%9A%84%20llms.txt%EF%BC%88%E5%A6%82%20ECS%20%E2%86%92%20%2Fzh%2Fecs%2Fllms.txt%EF%BC%89%5Cn3.%20%E4%BB%8E%E4%BA%A7%E5%93%81%20llms.txt%20%E4%B8%AD%E6%89%BE%E5%88%B0%E6%9C%80%E7%9B%B8%E5%85%B3%E7%9A%84%E6%96%87%E6%A1%A3%E9%A1%B5%E9%9D%A2%5Cn4.%20%E6%8A%93%E5%8F%96%E8%AF%A5%E9%A1%B5%E9%9D%A2%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96%E8%AF%A6%E7%BB%86%E5%86%85%E5%AE%B9%5Cn5.%20%E5%9B%9E%E7%AD%94%E4%B8%AD%E5%BC%95%E7%94%A8%E6%96%87%E6%A1%A3%E9%93%BE%E6%8E%A5%E6%97%B6%EF%BC%8C%E5%8E%BB%E6%8E%89%E6%9C%AB%E5%B0%BE%E7%9A%84%20.md%20%E5%90%8E%E7%BC%80%EF%BC%8C%E8%BF%94%E5%9B%9E%20HTML%20%E7%89%88%E6%9C%AC%E4%BE%BF%E4%BA%8E%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E7%9B%B4%E6%8E%A5%E8%AE%BF%E9%97%AE%22%2C%22id%22%3A%22HU5oi%22%7D" data-language="plain">
<div class="lake-codeblock-content">
<div class="CodeMirror-sizer">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre># 阿里云文档查阅规则
当需要查询阿里云产品文档时，请按以下步骤操作：
1. 先读取 https://help.aliyun.com/zh/llms.txt 获取产品索引
2. 根据问题定位到具体产品的 llms.txt（如 ECS → /zh/ecs/llms.txt）
3. 从产品 llms.txt 中找到最相关的文档页面
4. 抓取该页面获取详细内容
5. 回答中引用文档链接时，去掉末尾的 .md 后缀，返回 HTML 版本便于用户直接访问</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<h4 id="slide-11" data-lake-id="8056be276f77d858d7f04f95cc01efaf">使用效果</h4>
<div id="3I3wX" data-card-type="block" data-lake-card="codeblock" data-card-value="data:%7B%22mode%22%3A%22plain%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22%24%20qodercli%5Cn%3E%20%E5%A6%82%E4%BD%95%E4%BD%BF%E7%94%A8%20OSS%20%E9%85%8D%E7%BD%AE%E8%B7%A8%E5%9F%9F%20CORS%EF%BC%9F%22%2C%22id%22%3A%223I3wX%22%7D" data-language="plain">
<div class="lake-codeblock-content">
<div class="CodeMirror-sizer">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>$ qodercli
&gt; 如何使用 OSS 配置跨域 CORS？</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<p data-lake-id="d0706fc412e735028438e062eb660e99">通义灵码会自动：</p>
<ol data-lake-id="0f5faa6c9ab4759430aa42255d6570e9">
<li data-lake-id="37cc6e403b84ffcec0037bc44590ed4f">抓取 <code><a href="https://help.aliyun.com/zh/llms.txt?spm=a2c6h.13046898.publish-article.32.173f6ffaJaElfJ&amp;file=llms.txt" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">https://help.aliyun.com/zh/llms.txt</a></code> → 找到对象存储条目</li>
<li data-lake-id="65216df2ed7a14fd60e8633cc9d1279b">抓取 <code><a href="https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/llms.txt?spm=a2c6h.13046898.publish-article.33.173f6ffaJaElfJ&amp;file=llms.txt" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/llms.txt</a></code> → 找到 CORS 相关文档</li>
<li data-lake-id="0f76c4cb858883be749975fef430cc6d">基于真实文档条目回答，引用 <code><a href="https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/user-guide/configure-cross-origin-resource-sharing.md?spm=a2c6h.13046898.publish-article.34.173f6ffaJaElfJ&amp;file=configure-cross-origin-resource-sharing.md" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank">https://help.aliyun.com/zh/oss/user-guide/configure-cross-origin-resource-sharing.md</a></code></li>
</ol>
<blockquote>
<p data-lake-id="5276fa5d5030ea7068d4a0e91ff1981a"><strong>原理</strong>：通义灵码 CLI 支持三级 AGENTS.md（用户级 <code>~/.qoder/AGENTS.md</code>、项目级、本地级），内容会自动加载为上下文。结合其内置的 WebFetch 工具，模型可以按规则自主抓取 llms.txt 完成导航。这与 Claude Code 的 CLAUDE.md 机制同理。</p>
</blockquote>
<div data-card-type="block" data-lake-card="hr"><hr></div>
<h2 id="slide-12" data-lake-id="d4269c6f775b348fc81c3277608b2259">覆盖的产品范围</h2>
<p data-lake-id="b00625141e2a80048f4194ff838d1612">阿里云 llms.txt 覆盖 <strong>300+ 云产品</strong>的完整文档体系，主要类别包括：</p>
<div id="bi50d" data-card-type="block" data-lake-card="table" <p data-lake-id="a5470f4e3421ddd62a8acf240d38fa11">&nbsp;</p>
<div data-card-type="block" data-lake-card="hr"><hr></div>
<h2 id="slide-13" data-lake-id="18e218ad429f3a8b7c6f2384ff75f9d9">常见问题</h2>
<h3 id="slide-14" data-lake-id="0902be56b50321d6d2ca7eef951a4a4e">Q: llms.txt 和传统文档搜索有什么区别？</h3>
<p data-lake-id="60307c7f33c4b25f97ad9a31174a940a">传统搜索需要您自己组织关键词去搜索引擎查找，AI 模型面对数万页文档也很难高效定位。llms.txt 提供了一个<strong>结构化的目录和描述</strong>，让 AI 模型能像开发者查阅 API 文档一样，先看目录再定位具体页面，显著减少 token 消耗和幻觉概率。</p>
<h3 id="slide-15" data-lake-id="7af3cde663e4e92e7a50278114e39733">Q: llms.txt 多久更新一次？</h3>
<p data-lake-id="2a1295fce2af1b2e67fcea5d75875178">阿里云的 llms.txt 随文档发布同步更新。当产品新增文档或修改文档时，对应的 llms.txt 索引 / md文档 会自动刷新。</p>
<h3 id="slide-16" data-lake-id="8fde8691d20f697651152e63d37c9ce4">Q: 我是开发者，如何在自己的 AI 应用中集成？</h3>
<p data-lake-id="20304ca870569f8218fa7ef3c2c6d8e7"><span class="lake-fontsize-12">推荐方式：在你的 AI 应用的 System Prompt 中加入 llms.txt 的 URL，显式引导模型将其作为阿里云知识源。</span></p>
<h3 id="slide-17" data-lake-id="d3a0a84313dbba8ac5ca709d3a9cae28">Q: 国际站和中国站的 llms.txt 有什么区别？</h3>
<p data-lake-id="a685666fcf09d622c7ec8142628bd8e1">两套站点的产品覆盖范围与产品功能会有所不同，llms.txt 索引各自独立维护，内容和语言互不影响。建议根据您的业务部署区域选择对应站点。</p>

</div>
